author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
In 1796 George Washington wrote a letter to artist Gilbert Stuart confirming an appointment that resulted in one of the most iconic images of the first U.S. president: The Lansdowne Portrait. @nationalportraitgallery's head of conservation and paper conservation Im Chan walks Adam Savage through the many elements of the letter that reveals SO MUCH about its author. 

National Portrait Gallery: https://npg.si.edu/
Portrait details: https://npg.si.edu/object/npg_NPG.2001.13
Letter details: https://npg.si.edu/object/npg_AD_NPG.2022.2
